chunks.en: I need to open a bank account.
accept: I need to open an account.
I'd like to open a bank account.
chunks.note: 說明來銀行要辦什麼事。need to + 動詞原形 = 需要做某事。

distractors.text: I need open a bank account.
I need to open bank account.
I need to open a bank acount.

chunks.note: 不知道要在哪裡等的時候問。Where 後面接 do I + 動詞原形。

distractors.text: Where I do wait?
Where does I wait?
Where do I waiting?

chunks.note: 拿出證件時問對方能不能用。okay 也可以寫成 OK。

distractors.text: Is okay my passport?
Are my passport okay?
Is my pasport okay?

chunks.en: This bill has my new address.
chunks.zh: 這張帳單上有我的新地址。
chunks.note: 拿帳單證明住址時說。主詞 this bill 是一張，動詞用 has。

distractors.text: This bill have my new address.
This bill has my address new.
This bill has my new adress.

chunks.zh: 可以幫我看一下表格嗎？
accept: Could you check my form, please?
Could you please check my form?
chunks.note: Could you + 動詞原形…? 是客氣的請求，比 Can you 更有禮貌。

distractors.text: Could you checking my form?
Could you to check my form?
Could check you my form?

chunks.note: 聽不懂或看不懂時說，請對方再解釋。don't = do not，後面接動詞原形。

distractors.text: Sorry, I not understand.
Sorry, I doesn't understand.
Sorry, I don't understant.

chunks.note: 問機器怎麼用。the ATM 是一台，所以用 does，work 不加 s。

distractors.text: How does the ATM works?
How the ATM does work?
How does ATM work?

chunks.en: Can I take out sixty dollars?
accept: Can I take sixty dollars out?
chunks.note: take out = 把錢領出來，口語都這樣說。sixty 以上的 dollars 要加 s。

distractors.text: Can I take out sixty dollar?
Can I taking out sixty dollars?
Can I take out sixty dolars?

chunks.en: I'd like to deposit some cash.
accept: I would like to deposit some cash.
chunks.note: 要存錢時說。I'd like to = I would like to，比 I want to 客氣。

distractors.text: I'd like deposit some cash.
I'd like to deposit some cashes.
I'd like to depositing some cash.

chunks.en: When can I use the money?
chunks.zh: 這筆錢什麼時候可以用？
chunks.note: 存錢後問什麼時候能用。When 開頭的問句，can 要放在 I 前面。

distractors.text: When I can use the money?
When can I use the moneys?
When can I using the money?

chunks.en: Do I have to pay a fee?
accept: Do I need to pay a fee?
chunks.note: have to = 必須；問句用 Do I have to + 動詞原形？must 也是必須，語氣更強。

distractors.text: Do I have pay a fee?
Do I has to pay a fee?
Do I have to paying a fee?

chunks.note: 問費用是不是每個月都收。every 後面接單數：every month，前面不加 in。

distractors.text: Is that every months?
Is that in every month?
Is that evry month?

chunks.en: Can I pay my rent online?
chunks.zh: 房租可以在網路上付嗎？
accept: Can I pay the rent online?
chunks.note: 問能不能在網路上付錢。online = 在網路上，放在句尾。

distractors.text: Can I online pay my rent?
Can I paying my rent online?
Can I pay my rent on line?

chunks.en: How do I send money home?
chunks.note: 問怎麼匯錢回家。home 前面不加 to；money 不加 s。

distractors.text: How do I send money to home?
How I do send money home?
How do I send moneys home?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning! What can I do for you?
scene.zh: 早安！有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I need to open a bank account.
scene.zh: 我想開個戶。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure! There are just two people before you.
scene.zh: 好的！你前面只有兩個人。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Where do I wait?
scene.zh: 我要在哪裡等？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Over there. Then I'll ask you some questions.
scene.zh: 在那邊。等一下我會問你幾個問題。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks for waiting. First, I need some information.
scene.zh: 久等了。首先，我需要一些資料。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is my passport okay?
scene.zh: 用護照可以嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Now, can you tell me your address?
scene.zh: 可以。那可以告訴我你的地址嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: This bill has my new address.
scene.zh: 這張帳單上有我的新地址。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. And it's the same name as on your passport.
scene.zh: 很好。名字也跟護照上的一樣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: All done? The questions are easy, right?
scene.zh: 填好了嗎？問題都很簡單吧？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you check my form?
scene.zh: 可以幫我看一下表格嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. You need an answer here. What's your income?
scene.zh: 好啊。這裡要填。你的收入是多少？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, I don't understand.
scene.zh: 不好意思，我看不太懂。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your income is the money you make.
scene.zh: 收入就是你賺的錢。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's important. That's why we ask.
scene.zh: 這很重要，所以我們才會問。

question.en: When does the bank close on Saturday?
How much can you take out in a day?
question.zh: 一天最多可以領多少錢？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's your card. You can't use the ATM without it.
scene.zh: 這是你的卡。沒有它就不能用提款機。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How does the ATM work?
scene.zh: 提款機怎麼用？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's easy. Put your card in right here.
scene.zh: 很簡單。把卡插進這裡就好。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can I take out sixty dollars?
scene.zh: 我可以領六十塊嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. You can take out a thousand a day.
scene.zh: 可以。一天最多可以領一千塊。

fills.en: There ___ a bank on my street.
fills.zh: 我住的那條街上有一家銀行。
fills.note: a bank 是一個，用 There is。
want to 後面接動詞原形。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi again! What can I do for you today?
scene.zh: 又見面了！今天要辦什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd like to deposit some cash.
scene.zh: 我想存一些現金。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. The amount is ninety dollars and seventy cents.
scene.zh: 好的。金額是九十塊七毛。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: When can I use the money?
scene.zh: 這筆錢什麼時候可以用？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right now. It's good to save a little every week.
scene.zh: 現在就可以用。每個禮拜存一點是好事喔。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's your first statement. It shows your balance.
scene.zh: 這是你的第一張對帳單，上面有你的餘額。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I have to pay a fee?
scene.zh: 我要付手續費嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, we charge five dollars.
scene.zh: 要，我們收五塊錢。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is that every month?
scene.zh: 是每個月都要付嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. But with a balance over five hundred, it's free.
scene.zh: 對。不過餘額超過五百塊就免費。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's your new credit card. Don't spend too much!
scene.zh: 這是你的新信用卡。別花太多喔！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can I pay my rent online?
scene.zh: 房租可以在網路上付嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. You can make a payment on your phone.
scene.zh: 可以。你可以用手機付款。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How do I send money home?
scene.zh: 我要怎麼匯錢回家？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: With a transfer. The rate is different every day.
scene.zh: 用轉帳。不過匯率每天都不一樣喔。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning! How can I help you?
scene.zh: 早安！需要什麼幫忙嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I need to open a bank account.
scene.zh: 我想開個戶。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. First, you must show me some ID.
scene.zh: 好的。首先，你必須給我看證件。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is my passport okay?
scene.zh: 用護照可以嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, that's okay. Please answer the questions on this form.
scene.zh: 可以。請回答這張表格上的問題。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you check my form?
scene.zh: 可以幫我看一下表格嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. It all looks good. Here's your new card.
scene.zh: 好啊。都沒問題。這是你的新卡。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How does the ATM work?
scene.zh: 提款機怎麼用？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's easy. Just put your card in. Anything else?
scene.zh: 很簡單，把卡插進去就好。還有別的事嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd like to deposit some cash.
scene.zh: 我想存一些現金。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. Eighty dollars. It's in your account now.
scene.zh: 好的，八十塊。已經存進你的帳戶了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I have to pay a fee?
scene.zh: 我要付手續費嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, five dollars. You can see it on your statement.
scene.zh: 要，五塊錢。對帳單上看得到。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is that every month?
scene.zh: 是每個月都要付嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, but not if your balance is over five hundred.
scene.zh: 對，不過餘額超過五百塊就不用。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can I pay my rent online?
scene.zh: 房租可以在網路上付嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. You can also transfer money to another bank.
scene.zh: 可以。你也可以轉帳到別家銀行。
